description: This file is a PHP script embedded within an HTML page. It performs network configuration operations such as retrieving, setting, adding, and deleting NAT port mapping parameters using specific functions like DmGetStrsWithRootObj, DmSetStrsWithRootObj, DmGetInstanceIds, DmAddObj, and DmDelObj. The script outputs the results and states of these operations, demonstrating interactions with device configuration objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script execution performing various device configuration operations and outputting their results.
